## Type of Change

<!-- Check ONE box only. If both apply, split into separate PRs. -->

- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** — Fixes a defect without changing security posture
- [ ] ✨ **Feature** — New functionality, improvements, or non-security changes
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking Change** — Would cause existing functionality to not work as expected
- [ ] 📝 **Documentation** — Docs only, no code changes
- [ ] 🔒 **Baseline/Security** — Changes to CI, security config, or trust boundaries

> ⚠️ **If Baseline/Security**: Add the `security-maintenance` label. See [SECURITY_BASELINE.md](../docs/SECURITY_BASELINE.md).

## Checklist

### All PRs

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes

### If Baseline/Security Change

- [ ] I have added the `security-maintenance` label
- [ ] This PR does NOT mix security changes with feature work
- [ ] A CODEOWNER has been requested for review
- [ ] I have documented why this change is necessary below
